verdict.rationale: Brave's API page advertises a self-serve credit model ('Up to $20 in free calls every month · Prepaid credits, no subscription'), and a community reply says developers can switch themselves to a separate AI-inference plan, so pricing appears to be published and self-serve rather than sales-gated. However, the pack never states an actual per-request or per-1,000-call rate, so the 'clear per-request pricing' part is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit per-request/per-credit price figures, a documented pricing page or tier breakdown (including AI-plan rates), independent confirmation that no sales contact is needed.
